name: Summer Elements (Nature Camp & Adventure Camp)
description_short: Outdoor drop-off nature day camp at Round The Bend Farm in South Dartmouth, MA, running Tuesday to Thursday, 9am to 3pm. Nature Camp (ages 5-9) and Adventure Camp (ages 9-13) each have a different weekly theme, such as insects, foraging, woodworking or nature journals.
refund_policy_summary: A $50 deposit per session per child is due at registration. It is non-refundable and counts toward the total cost. The rest is due by June 12. If you cancel more than 4 weeks before the session starts, you get a refund minus the $50 deposit. If you cancel within 4 weeks of the start, there is no refund.

sessions.name: Nature Camp Week 2: Birds of Prey

Each weekly session runs only 3 days (Tuesday to Thursday), 9am to 3pm.
